description: This file defines the Border class for parsing and handling border styles in an XML-based spreadsheet reader, including mapping border styles, parsing style data, and handling border positions and colors.

classes.name: Border
classes.description: Class for parsing and managing border styles within the XML style reader of PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Parses border style information from an XML element and returns an array of style attributes.

methods.name: parsePosition
methods.description: Determines border position and diagonal direction based on style attribute values.
